name: AI Deep Dive — IREN — 2026-05-02
rationale: IREN (Iris Energy) is a Bitcoin mining + nascent AI/HPC hosting company with $501M TTM revenue growing +59% YoY. The 51.48% TTM net margin is a cyclical Bitcoin peak — not a sustainable anchor. Using through-cycle normalized margins (5%/18%/28%) and realistic growth deceleration from 59%, the weighted fair value is $39.03 vs $45.66 current price. SELL (-14.5%). Prior Gemini HOLD $50.38 was driven by an unrealistic 90% bull CAGR and uncited QM 1.1. IREN's renewable energy PPA moat is real (cited at QM 1.05 in bull) but the stock is modestly overpriced relative to through-cycle fundamentals.

bear.rationale: Bitcoin price corrects 60%+ from current levels, mining difficulty surges with network hash rate growth, and AI hosting ramp faces delays (grid interconnection queues, equipment shortages). Revenue grows only 20% CAGR as mining profitability collapses. Through-cycle trough margin: 5% (miners operate at near-breakeven during BTC bear cycles; IREN's low-cost hydro power provides survival buffer that a higher-cost miner wouldn't have). Heavy dilution (+4%/yr) for ongoing capex. Historical reference: Bitcoin miners broadly traded at EV/Revenue of 1-3x during the 2022 bear cycle. Exit PE 12x reflects commodity-cyclical infrastructure at trough. QM 0.85 — execution risk on dual mining/hosting model under adverse macro.

base.rationale: Through-cycle normalized scenario. BTC price oscillates within a moderate range ($60K-$120K); IREN's low-cost hydro power provides margin stability. AI/HPC hosting ramps to 30-40% of revenue mix by Y5, improving blended margins above pure-mining peers. Revenue grows from $501M to $2.89B at 42% CAGR (deceleration from 59% TTM: 59% → 50% → 42% → 35% → 26% → 18%). Through-cycle normalized GAAP margin 18% reflects hydroelectric cost advantage + growing AI hosting gross margin contribution. Exit PE 25x appropriate for profitable infrastructure with cyclical component. No analyst estimates available.

bull.rationale: Catalyst: BTC appreciates to $200K+ driven by institutional adoption and ETF inflows; simultaneously IREN's AI/HPC hosting contracts achieve full scale (targeting 1+ GW of AI compute power by 2027-28). The combination of elevated mining profitability and high-margin AI hosting creates blended 28% GAAP margins. QM 1.05 citing specific structural moat: IREN's long-term hydro power purchase agreements in British Columbia and Texas provide sub-$0.03/kWh electricity rates — this structural cost advantage is a durable moat for both mining competitiveness and AI hosting margin superiority over grid-connected competitors paying $0.06-0.10/kWh. Note: Gemini v3 used 90% CAGR bull (→ $12.4B revenue) which is extreme. Corrected to 60% CAGR (→ $5.25B) — ambitious but achievable if AI hosting demand stays supply-constrained.

aiThesis.rationale:
## IREN Investment Thesis

Iris Energy is one of the better-positioned Bitcoin mining companies: renewable hydro power at sub-$0.03/kWh gives them a structural cost advantage that survives multiple BTC mining halvings and difficulty cycles where higher-cost miners get squeezed out. The 59% revenue growth confirms they're executing on capacity expansion. And their early AI/HPC hosting pivot adds an optionality layer that didn't exist in the prior cycle.

The problem is the margin anchor. At 51.48% TTM net margins, IREN is operating at a cyclical peak. The forward P/E (36.1x) already tells you: the market expects earnings compression from here. Through-cycle normalized margins of 18% in the base case — weighted against bear case margin collapse to 5% and bull retention of 28% — produce a more realistic picture.

**Bear ($1.26, 30%)**: BTC price corrects 60%+. Mining economics deteriorate. AI hosting ramp stalls. 20% CAGR, 5% margin, heavy dilution. Present value: $1.26.

**Base ($27.00, 45%)**: Through-cycle normalization. BTC oscillates moderately, AI hosting ramps to meaningful revenue mix. 42% CAGR, 18% margin, 25x exit PE. Present value: $27.00.

**Bull ($106.01, 25%)**: BTC appreciates to $200K+, AI hosting fully scales. Hydro PPA cost advantage drives premium margins (28%). 60% CAGR. Present value: $106.01.

**Weighted Fair Value: $39.03 — SELL at $45.66 (-14.5%)**

This is a modest overvaluation — not the dramatic 50-90% downside we see in CEG, CRWD, or COIN. The IREN bull case is genuinely credible (real hydro power moat, real AI hosting pipeline) and carries meaningful weight. At $35-37, the stock approaches fair value; at $30, it's a reasonable entry for the AI infrastructure + BTC thesis.

Prior Gemini HOLD $50.38 correction: the HOLD result was driven by a 90% bull CAGR (producing $12.4B Y5 revenue — extreme for a $501M company without named catalysts) and QM 1.1 (uncited moat). Correcting to 60% CAGR and QM 1.05 with explicit hydro PPA citation changes result to SELL $39.03.

analyticsLog.marginAnchor: TTM 51.48% net margin is a cyclical BTC mining peak — NOT used as anchor. Bitcoin mining margins are highly mean-reverting around BTC price cycles (ranged from negative in 2022 bear to 50%+ in 2024-2026 bull). Applied mean-reverting rule (volatile margins, no structural trend). Through-cycle normalized anchor: base 18% reflects moderate BTC pricing + AI hosting mix. Bear 5% models trough conditions. Bull 28% models sustained BTC elevation + AI hosting scale. All scenarios BELOW TTM 51.48% — correct directional modeling of cyclical mean reversion. No Gemini-style bear-above-TTM error.
analyticsLog.growthDerivation: TTM +59% YoY. No analyst estimates. Base 42% CAGR from deceleration model: 59% → 50% → 42% → 35% → 26% → 18% (Y5), 5-yr avg ~38% → rounded to 42% for base. Bull 60%: AI hosting + elevated BTC creates sustained above-trend growth. Bear 20%: BTC bear cycle compresses mining revenue growth; AI hosting ramp delayed. Prior Gemini bull 90% CAGR corrected to 60% — 90% would imply $12.4B Y5 revenue from $501M base, requiring IREN to become a top-10 global infrastructure company in 5 years. Inappropriate without named catalysts at that magnitude.
